Overview

Both files are AnnData (.h5ad) pseudobulk matrices: each row is one (AIFI_L3 cell type × sample) group, each column a gene, with three aggregation layers — sum (UMI counts), means (mean Seurat-normalized expression) and detect (cells expressing the gene). Matrices are stored sparse (CSC); there is no dense X. Statistics below are computed by streaming the layers in chunks (the Sound Life file is ~12 GB) plus full analysis of the rich obs metadata. The two datasets are complementary: Sound Life follows healthy adults longitudinally through influenza vaccination, while Immunobiology of Aging samples a wide age range once.

Sound Life

Longitudinal scRNA-seq from a healthy-adult flu-vaccination study (cohorts BR1=younger, BR2=older). Pseudobulk aggregated per (AIFI_L3 cell type × sample) with sum / means / detect layers.
